name: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
benefit: - **Subsidy Assistance for Area Expansion Using Hybrid Seeds:** 40% of unit cost or up to ₹20,000/- per hectare, whichever is less.- **Promotion of Natural Farming in Vegetable Crops:** Maximum Assistance: ₹20,000/- per hectare.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable crop cultivation.
